column1: # Names, SHAs and outcomes only: the code is private and this repository is public.
# Recovered at S3b's opening from board snapshots, `gh` and the tier-2 transcripts;
# the reviewed head is the commit the reviewer saw, not the merge. <repo> is a
# `expect` is what the probe MEASURED at S3b, not what the done-when first hoped
# for: the redglass rows were meant to pass and did not (the epic's FL5 has the
# triage). `must-report` pins lines the result must name, so C21 bounces for tier
# 2's reason and not merely for some reason. Each pin is the SHA-256 of
# "<file>:<line>:<source>" as the probe reports it, so it names nothing a reader
# of this public file could not already see; `-` pins nothing. redglass-5's base
# is the merge-base: its recorded baseRefOid postdates the head the reviewer saw
